description:
The model quality/speed indicator ('medium') is missing from the status bar.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
No quality indicator shown after model name

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
'minimax/minimax-m2.7 • medium' - the '• medium' suffix indicates model quality/speed setting

The quality indicator (e.g., 'medium', 'fast', 'high') should appear after the model name, separated by ' • '.
title: TUI-3: Missing model quality/speed indicator ('medium') in status bar
